description: This Java class `DefaultDevOpsConfig` implements the `DevOpsConfig` interface, representing configuration related to DevOps security settings such as secure status and passwords. It provides methods to instantiate the configuration from a Typesafe `Config` object, and overrides standard methods like `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString`.

classes.name: DefaultDevOpsConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing DevOpsConfig, handling DevOps security configurations such as secure status and passwords.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance of DefaultDevOpsConfig from a Config object.

methods.name: isSecureStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the DevOps status is secure.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used in DevOps configuration.
